 Search The Bieber Effect: Why Korea is Still Obsessed with Justin Bieber [Pop-Up This Weekend!]
 lewishooper1 3 days ago 3 min read From Seongsu street fashion to endless K-pop crossovers, exploring Korea’s unyielding love for the global pop icon. 
 The Bieber Effect is still making noise. From inspiring K-pop idols to connecting with Korean fans, Justin Bieber’s influence reaches beyond the charts. ( Justin Bieber’s Instagram) Seoul’s trendsetting district of Seongsu-dong , which has become increasingly popular with tourists, is hosting Justin Bieber’s brand, SKYLRK , for a limited four-day pop-up. This event will run from October 22 to 25, 2026 , and will showcase Justin’s streetwear range and even Justin himself, as he touched down at Incheon International Airport on October 22, 2026, with his wife, Hailey Bieber . 
 Why Koreans Love Him 
 Justin Bieber has been a global household name ever since he debuted. Koreans love Justin Bieber as they are able to connect to his catchy, emotional vocals and deep messages, which consistently top the Korean music charts, such as Melon. 
 Although Korea is famous for its domestic K-pop, many K-pop artists have been known to cover Justin Bieber’s tracks, such as Henry from Begin Again Korea . Justin Bieber has been a big influence on many Koreans growing up, and Justin’s new fashion brand has also become a talking point amongst many young Koreans as of late. 
 What’s Happening 
 SKYLRK has trended online following its massive success in Tokyo and New York. Visitors to the pop-up store will, however, have to fight off queues of people, as the experience, featuring exclusive drops and, if you are lucky, even a glimpse of Justin himself, is about to become the center of Seoul. Will you be able to get your hands on some of these limited one-of-a-kind pieces? 
 About the Store & Event 
 Justin Bieber Seongsu Seoul - Instagram Justin Bieber Located at 36 Seongsuil-ro 6-gil , the space pairs minimalist retail design with interactive lifestyle features. Guests can shop the collection while playing on a custom STIGA x SKYLRK table tennis table set up inside, which the Dojeon Media team really loves the look of. 
 Huge queues were reported to have formed early in Seongsu, with attendees praising the high-energy vibe and interactive ping-pong table, which made the long wait even more worthwhile. Fans especially love the Seoul-branded merch and the chance to test out the portable DOMO speakers live, which look and sound awesome! 
 The Product Range & Seoul Exclusives 
 Justin Bieber's STIGA x SKYLRK range - https://blog.namanecard.com/ There is also set to be an exclusive line-up at “SKYLRK SEOUL”, featuring one-off pieces alongside footwear and eyewear options that simply look awesome. It also marks the premiere of the brand’s first audio release, the DOMO speaker , adorned with its signature smile logo, which is probably why Justin has come to Seoul himself to oversee the launch and make it more successful. 
   DOMO speaker / SKYLARK - Justin Bieber - Instagram SKYLARK. The Seongsu pop-up's estimated prices range roughly from ₩90,000 to ₩180,000 ($70–$140 USD) for tees and accessories, with signature hoodies and speakers spanning ₩200,000 to ₩380,000 ($150–$280 USD). Despite some of the prices sounding high, they are competitive with other artists' labels. 
 SKYLRK SEOUL - Instagram Justin Bieber Final Thoughts 
 For the Dojeon Media team, this Seongsu pop-up really does go to show that, despite being the home of some amazing K-pop artists, Koreans still have time for global stars like Justin Bieber . Justin’s influence, both musically and through his streetwear brand, merges to create something truly iconic. Will this potentially lead to a concert in Seoul later this year or next year?
